new_assertions.title: coarse target identification changes scalar constraint satisfiability
new_assertions.body: For the shortest 5x4 witness with unchanged four edge deltas, identifying the two residual-distinct final targets as one quotient node yields an unsatisfiable one-bit node-potential system, while retaining them as two targets distinguished by the represented residual bit yields a satisfiable system.

new_assertions.title: quotient-level scalar obstruction does not imply obstruction on every refinement
new_assertions.body: The shortest 5x4 witness is an explicit model in which scalar Boolean node-potential semantics fails on the current coarse quotient but succeeds on a represented strict refinement; therefore quotient-level scalar obstruction alone does not imply scalar obstruction on every finer state carrier.
new_assertions.scope: logical non-implication witnessed by the shortest 5x4 obstruction/refinement pair

new_assertions.title: a history-free state-local repair exists for the shortest witness
new_assertions.body: There exists a repair of the shortest scalar contradiction that uses only represented endpoint residual-state information to refine the target and does not require accumulated transporter identity or source-frame action history as part of the refined node identity.

new_assertions.title: the shortest obstruction is a quotient-sensitive rather than quotient-invariant fact
new_assertions.body: Whether the shortest 5x4 edge observations admit a scalar Boolean node potential depends on the declared state-identification relation: the answer is false under the current target merge and true under the represented residual-bit target refinement.
new_assertions.scope: shortest 5x4 witness under the two explicitly represented state-identification relations

add_fixed: one scalar Boolean coordinate is locally sufficient after a strict residual-state refinement of the shortest witness
retain_open: whether a scalar Boolean phase exists after a principled refinement of the complete 5x4 carrier
whether more than one Boolean coordinate is required for other obstructions
whether a non-binary/non-abelian carrier is required globally

rejected_candidates.body: All 25 5x4 nonzero syndromes are quotient artifacts repaired by one residual bit.
rejected_candidates.reason: Only one concrete obstruction has been closed under the one-bit refinement.

rejected_candidates.body: The complete corrected 5x4 carrier is scalar-integrable.
rejected_candidates.reason: No complete refined-carrier construction or all-cycle proof is represented.
